2,000 Feet of Lake Erie Waterfront. A Rare Luxury Estate & Resort Opportunity

42+ Acres | Approximately 2,000 Feet of Lake Erie Shoreline | Exceptional Luxury Potential

Imagine creating a destination unlike anything else along the shores of Lake Erie.

This extraordinary waterfront property, featuring approximately 2,000 feet of Lake Erie shoreline, presents a rare opportunity to create a magnificent private luxury estate, exclusive wellness retreat, boutique resort, or signature residential enclave.

Formerly the Sugar Hill Golf Course, the property combines expansive acreage, remarkable shoreline, sweeping water views, privacy, and unforgettable Lake Erie sunsets. Few properties offer this combination of scale and waterfront in a single setting.

Envision a spectacular legacy waterfront estate with expansive grounds, guest residences, recreational amenities, gardens, and private spaces overlooking the lake.

Or explore the potential for a carefully designed luxury residential community that takes advantage of the property's exceptional setting and extensive Lake Erie frontage.

The possibilities are limited only by vision and applicable governmental approvals.

A Lake Erie Property Without Equal

Properties with this amount of acreage and Lake Erie frontage rarely become available. This is more than an offering of waterfront land—it is an opportunity to create a landmark Lake Erie destination.

Whether envisioned as a private family legacy property, exclusive retreat, or sophisticated residential community, these 42+ acres provide an extraordinary setting in which to create something truly special.

An exceptional property. An extraordinary shoreline. A once-in-a-generation opportunity.
